SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 'SOURCE' AS entity_type, s.id AS entity_id, s.title AS title, s.title AS search_text, CASE WHEN s.title = #{exactQuery} THEN 100 WHEN s.title LIKE #{prefixPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 80 WHEN s.title LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 60
WHEN MATCH(s.title) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 THEN 50
ELSE 0 END AS score, s.id AS source_id, NULL AS source_asset_id, NULL AS source_page_id, NULL AS page_number, NULL AS knowledge_point_id, NULL AS question_id, NULL AS note_id,
MATCH(s.title) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) 0
AS ft_relevance, CONCAT('SOURCE|', LPAD(s.id, 20, '0')) AS sort_key FROM source s JOIN learning_space ls ON ls.id = s.space_id WHERE s.space_id = #{spaceId} AND ls.owner_subject = #{ownerSubject} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ( s.title LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' OR MATCH(s.title) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 ) UNION ALL
SELECT 'CONTENT_BLOCK' AS entity_type, cb.id AS entity_id, SUBSTRING(cb.normalized_text, 1, 120) AS title, cb.normalized_text AS search_text, CASE WHEN cb.normalized_text = #{exactQuery} THEN 40 WHEN cb.normalized_text LIKE #{prefixPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 30 WHEN cb.normalized_text LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 20
WHEN MATCH(cb.normalized_text) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 THEN 10
ELSE 0 END AS score, cb.source_id AS source_id, sp.source_asset_id AS source_asset_id, cb.source_page_id AS source_page_id, sp.source_page_number AS page_number, NULL AS knowledge_point_id, NULL AS question_id, NULL AS note_id,
MATCH(cb.normalized_text) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) 0
AS ft_relevance, CONCAT('CONTENT_BLOCK|', LPAD(cb.id, 20, '0')) AS sort_key FROM content_block cb JOIN source_page sp ON sp.id = cb.source_page_id AND sp.space_id = cb.space_id AND sp.source_id = cb.source_id JOIN source s ON s.id = cb.source_id AND s.space_id = cb.space_id JOIN learning_space ls ON ls.id = cb.space_id WHERE cb.space_id = #{spaceId} AND ls.owner_subject = #{ownerSubject} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (s.current_extraction_revision_id IS NULL OR cb.extraction_revision_id = s.current_extraction_revision_id) AND ( cb.normalized_text LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' OR MATCH(cb.normalized_text) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 ) UNION ALL
SELECT 'KNOWLEDGE_POINT' AS entity_type, kp.id AS entity_id, kp.title AS title, CONCAT_WS(' ', kp.title, IFNULL(kp.summary, ''), IFNULL(kp.content, '') ) AS search_text, CASE WHEN kp.title = #{exactQuery} THEN 100 WHEN kp.title LIKE #{prefixPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 80 WHEN kp.title LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 60 WHEN kp.summary LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 40 WHEN kp.content LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 20
WHEN MATCH(kp.title, kp.summary, kp.content) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 THEN 10
ELSE 0 END AS score, NULL AS source_id, NULL AS source_asset_id, NULL AS source_page_id, NULL AS page_number, kp.id AS knowledge_point_id, NULL AS question_id, NULL AS note_id,
MATCH(kp.title, kp.summary, kp.content) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) 0
AS ft_relevance, CONCAT('KNOWLEDGE_POINT|', LPAD(kp.id, 20, '0')) AS sort_key FROM knowledge_point kp JOIN learning_space ls ON ls.id = kp.space_id WHERE kp.space_id = #{spaceId} AND ls.owner_subject = #{ownerSubject} AND kp.deleted_at IS NULL AND kp.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ( kp.title LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' OR kp.summary LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' OR kp.content LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' OR MATCH(kp.title, kp.summary, kp.content) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 ) UNION ALL
SELECT 'QUESTION' AS entity_type, q.id AS entity_id, q.stem AS title, q.stem AS search_text, CASE WHEN q.stem = #{exactQuery} THEN 60 WHEN q.stem LIKE #{prefixPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 40 WHEN q.stem LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 20
WHEN MATCH(q.stem) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 THEN 10
ELSE 0 END AS score, NULL AS source_id, NULL AS source_asset_id, NULL AS source_page_id, NULL AS page_number, NULL AS knowledge_point_id, q.id AS question_id, NULL AS note_id,
MATCH(q.stem) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) 0
AS ft_relevance, CONCAT('QUESTION|', LPAD(q.id, 20, '0')) AS sort_key FROM question q JOIN learning_space ls ON ls.id = q.space_id WHERE q.space_id = #{spaceId} AND ls.owner_subject = #{ownerSubject} AND q.deleted_at IS NULL AND q.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ( q.stem LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' OR MATCH(q.stem) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 ) UNION ALL
SELECT 'WRONG_QUESTION' AS entity_type, wq.id AS entity_id, q.stem AS title, q.stem AS search_text, CASE WHEN q.stem = #{exactQuery} THEN 60 WHEN q.stem LIKE #{prefixPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 40 WHEN q.stem LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 20
WHEN MATCH(q.stem) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 THEN 10
ELSE 0 END AS score, NULL AS source_id, NULL AS source_asset_id, NULL AS source_page_id, NULL AS page_number, NULL AS knowledge_point_id, wq.question_id AS question_id, NULL AS note_id,
MATCH(q.stem) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) 0
AS ft_relevance, CONCAT('WRONG_QUESTION|', LPAD(wq.id, 20, '0')) AS sort_key FROM wrong_question wq JOIN learning_space ls ON ls.id = wq.space_id JOIN question q ON q.id = wq.question_id AND q.space_id = wq.space_id AND q.deleted_at IS NULL AND q.status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE wq.space_id = #{spaceId} AND wq.user_subject = #{userSubject} AND ls.owner_subject = #{ownerSubject} AND ( q.stem LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' OR MATCH(q.stem) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 ) UNION ALL
SELECT 'NOTE' AS entity_type, n.id AS entity_id, n.title AS title, n.content AS search_text, CASE WHEN n.title = #{exactQuery} THEN 80 WHEN n.title LIKE #{prefixPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 60 WHEN n.content LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 30
WHEN MATCH(n.title, n.content) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 THEN 20
ELSE 0 END AS score, NULL AS source_id, NULL AS source_asset_id, NULL AS source_page_id, NULL AS page_number, NULL AS knowledge_point_id, NULL AS question_id, n.id AS note_id,
MATCH(n.title, n.content) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) 0
AS ft_relevance, CONCAT('NOTE|', LPAD(n.id, 20, '0')) AS sort_key FROM note n JOIN learning_space ls ON ls.id = n.space_id WHERE n.space_id = #{spaceId} AND n.user_subject_id = #{userSubject} AND ls.owner_subject = #{ownerSubject} AND n.archived_at IS NULL AND ( n.title LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' OR n.content LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' OR MATCH(n.title, n.content) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 ) UNION ALL
) AS results WHERE score > 0 ORDER BY score DESC, ft_relevance DESC, sort_key ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT 1 AS score_alias FROM question q JOIN learning_space ls ON ls.id = q.space_id WHERE q.space_id = #{spaceId} AND ls.owner_subject = #{ownerSubject} AND q.deleted_at IS NULL AND q.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ( q.stem LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' OR MATCH(q.stem) AGAINST (#{matchQuery} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 ) AND CASE WHEN q.stem = #{exactQuery} THEN 60 WHEN q.stem LIKE #{prefixPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 40 WHEN q.stem LIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\\' THEN 20
